updates.content:
Title: Users are unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings

User impact: Users are unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings.

More info: Users are unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings through Microsoft Graph API. Meeting-minutes and sales-visit-summary services are unavailable. Meetings since 9 October 2026 at 8:10 AM UTC aren't being processed, and change notifications have stopped.

Current status: We're reviewing support case details to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and users attempting to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings are impacted.

Next update by: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings

User impact: Users may be unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings.

Meetings since 9 October 2026 at 8:10 AM UTC may not be processed, and change notifications may have stopped. Users may also experience issues with /aiInsights (meeting AI summary) APIs.

Current status: We're reviewing diagnostic logs to formulate our next steps of our investigation to validate a root cause hypothesis.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users who may be attempting to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings.

Next update by: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users who may be attempting to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Title: Some users may be unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings

User impact: Users may have been unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings.

More info: Users may have been unable to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings through Microsoft Graph API. Meeting-minutes and sales-visit-summary services may have been unavailable. Meetings since 9 October 2026 at 8:10 AM UTC may not have been processed, and change notifications may have stopped. Users may also have experienced issues with /aiInsights (meeting AI summary) APIs.

Final status: After a period of monitoring service telemetry, we've validated that reverting the service update which introduced a regression has remediated the impact.

Scope of impact: Impact was specific to some users who attempted to access Microsoft Teams transcripts and recordings.

Start time: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 8:10 AM UTC

End time: Friday, October 9, 2026, at 2:40 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent standard service update introduced a regression which resulted in the impact.

Next steps: 
- We're evaluating our service update protocols to ensure similar regressions are identified and corrected ahead of deployments to prevent this from reoccurring.

This is the final update for the event.
